text:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups for last week's canary incident. Need clear owners/timelines for the auto-rollback and blast-radius controls we discussed.
Jay Patel: Agree. I'll take ownership of the auto-rollback rule draft. Target EOD Wed for a PR.
Rachel O'Neil: I'll own rollout gating docs and add the progressive ramp example. ETA Fri.
Tom Baxter: Can we add a short-term safety net: block >2% 5m error -> immediate rollback? We used 3% and it was too late.
Arjun Iyer: +1. Also add a check for 95th latency spike > 2000ms for 3m.
Leah Kim: I'll update the canary config template. Proposed defaults: start 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic hold on anomaly.
Maria Chen: Good. Action items: 
- Jay: draft auto-rollback rules + tests (EOD Wed)
- Rachel: rollout gating doc + examples (Fri)
- Leah: update canary template + add template validation (Mon)
- Arjun: add metric alerts + playbook snippets (Thu)
Tom Baxter: Where do we track these? Put in the postmortem tracker and link to PRs.
Rachel O'Neil: I'll create a GH project and add checkboxes, linking back to PM-123 (postmortem). Will ping when created.
deploy-bot: Deploy check: canary-policy-service v2.3.1 deployed to staging at 1955678950 :rocket:
Jay Patel: For the auto-rollback logic, suggestion:
```
if (error_rate_5m > 0.02) && (traffic_pct >= 5) {
  trigger_rollback("canary")
}
```
Add a cooldown per service to avoid oscillation.
Arjun Iyer: Also add a fallback tiering rule: when rollback triggers, route to last-known-good model variant + notify oncall.
Leah Kim: I'll add the template PR and include a short example of gating JSON.
Maria Chen: One more: track recurring incidents — create a recurring incident tag in the tracker and surface services with >=2 incidents in 90d.
Tom Baxter: Agree. That will help prioritize hardening.
Rachel O'Neil: Happy to shepherd the tracker change. I'll add an onboarding note for PMs and SREs.
Maria Chen: Ok — owners noted. Can we reconvene next Tue to verify PRs and finalize rollout SLOs? :calendar:
Jay Patel: Works for me. :thumbsup:
Leah Kim: Works.
Arjun Iyer: I'll be there.
Rachel O'Neil: Scheduled — will post meeting invite.
Tom Baxter: Thanks all. :eyes:
